Name: What's in the Grass
Author: dazuki
Description:
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dazuki/WhatsInTheGrass/main/.github/assets/header-text.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dazuki/WhatsInTheGrass/main/.github/assets/preview.webp[/img][/center]

[center][size=4]Fades tall grass that hides forage and farm animals, so truffles and your animals stay visible[/size][/center]


[left][size=5][b]This mod currently (un)covers...[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3][color=#d98f40][b]Forage[/b][/color] - Grass covering spawned forage (truffles, seasonal forage, etc...) fades so you can spot it easier.
[b][color=#d98f40]Farm animals[/color][/b] - Grass around farm animals that are outside fades in and out as they walk around.[/size][/left]

[left][size=5][b]Configuration (GMCM)[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3][b][color=#d98f40]Fade over forage[/color][/b] - On by default (default opacity 50%)
[b][color=#d98f40]Fade over animals[/color][/b] - On by default (default opacity 60%)[/size][/left]

[left][size=5][b]Install instructions[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3]1. Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download the latest release and unzip it into "[b]..\Stardew Valley\Mods[/b]".
3. Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/left]

[left][size=5][b]Extra mod compatibility[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48269]Launcher Drawer[/url][/size][/left]

[left][size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=3]A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/JennaJuffuffles]JennaJuffuffles[/url] for testing the mod and finding some sensible default settings!
Thanks also to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/GuXinMax]GuXinMax[/url] for reminding me that truffles can be hard to spot in grass and that something should exist to help with that![/size][/left]
